verdicts_or_reports.element: Capsule strength (mg) amount field / Unit selector
verdicts_or_reports.expected: When the preparation form is changed, every amount field including its selected unit should be carried over, so 50 μg entered on Tablet stays 50 μg (unit selector still μg) on Capsule.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After selecting the μg unit and entering 50 in "Tablet strength (μg)", switching Preparation form to Capsule keeps the number 50 but silently resets the unit to mg, showing "Capsule strength (mg)" with 50 mg; switching back to Tablet also shows mg. The user's 50 μg has become 50 mg (1000x the intended amount).
steps: Enter Medication name, set Unit to μg, enter 50 in the strength field (shows 'Tablet strength (μg)' with value 50)
Observe the amount field: it shows 'Capsule strength (mg)' with value 50 and the mg unit chip selected

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Changing the preparation form should carry over the amount field including its selected unit: μg should stay selected, so the field reads "Capsule strength (μg)".
verdicts_or_reports.observed: With Category Custom and Tablet selected, tapping the μg unit chip changes the field to "Tablet strength (μg)" and checks μg. Tapping the Capsule preparation form then resets the Unit selector to mg: the field reads "Capsule strength (mg)" with mg checked, so the selected μg unit is lost when only the preparation form is changed.
steps: Select Category: Custom (Preparation form stays Tablet)
Tap the μg Unit chip; the strength field becomes 'Tablet strength (μg)' with μg checked
Observe the amount field: it is 'Capsule strength (mg)' and the mg unit chip is checked

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Changing the preparation form should carry over the entered amount, so the 2 mg entered on Tablet appears in the Injection form's amount field ("Vial strength (mg)").
verdicts_or_reports.observed: With Preparation form Tablet and Tablet strength set to 2 mg, tapping Preparation form Injection shows an empty "Vial strength (mg)" field; the amount entered before the form change is not carried over.
steps: Open Plan > Medicines > Add medicine (Estradiol category, Tablet form)
Tap the 2 mg preset so Tablet strength shows 2
Observe the Injection amount field 'Vial strength (mg)' - it is empty instead of showing the 2 carried over from the Tablet form
